experiments.name: Guest checkout instead of forced account
experiments.hypothesis: Because 31% of visitors who begin checkout drop at the mandatory account-creation step (step rate 68.9%, both devices), we believe letting customers check out as guest will raise checkout completion, measured by purchase rate of checkout visitors.
experiments.evidence: reports/analysis-baseline.md §2: checkout_step1 step rate 68.9% (mobile 66.5%, desktop 71.4%) vs 92–95% for later steps.
experiments.decision: R3 B beats control on purchase: +44.1% (p=0.0000, P(beat)=1.000); guardrails OK.

experiments.name: Show shipping cost and free-shipping threshold in cart
experiments.hypothesis: Because checkouts paying €6.95 shipping lose 26% at the final 'place order' step vs 4.5% for free-shipping orders, and shipping cost is first shown at checkout, we believe showing shipping cost and the €100 free-shipping threshold in the cart will reduce surprise abandonment and lift conversion, measured by purchase rate of cart visitors.
experiments.evidence: reports/analysis-baseline.md §4: add_payment_info→purchase 73.6% (pays shipping) vs 95.5% (free shipping); cart says 'Shipping calculated at checkout'.
experiments.decision: R3 B beats control on purchase: +22.3% (p=0.0028, P(beat)=0.998); guardrails OK.

experiments.name: Mobile PDP: get Add to bag above the fold
experiments.hypothesis: Because mobile PDP→add-to-cart is 10.6% vs 15.9% on desktop (ratio 0.67) across all categories and price bands, and on a 390px screen the tall 3-image gallery pushes 'Add to bag' below the fold, we believe making the button visible without scrolling will raise mobile add-to-cart rate.
experiments.evidence: reports/analysis-baseline.md §3 (dev × cat and price-band cuts all show the gap; not category- or price-driven).
experiments.decision: R3 B_compact_gallery beats control on add_to_cart: +53.4% (p=0.0000, P(beat)=1.000); guardrails OK.
